note.zh: 367：最后一批守卫蒂扬奇家园的舰队被歼灭（全局一次）；370：最后一只蒂扬奇被杀死（全局一次）。两者各自发出，随后都可引出 371。
note.en: 367: the last fleets guarding the Tiyanki home are destroyed (once per galaxy); 370: the last Tiyanki is killed (once per galaxy). Each fires on its own and both may lead to 371.

scope.zh: 两种触发（家园被清空 / 物种灭绝）、告知条件与衰落帝国的跨国通讯均已核对。
scope.en: The two triggers (home cleared / species extinct), the informing conditions and the Fallen Empire transmission were checked.
